The plate is a square dinner plate of roughly 26 cm. It holds a small pile of cooked greens (chard) and some green beans or long beans, covering about a third of the plate.

I estimated the greens at about 80 g, since cooked chard is compact. The beans look like about 70 g. That puts the total near 150 g.

Energy is low for vegetables: about 25 kcal per 100 g for the greens and about 35 kcal per 100 g for the beans. Visible oil adds some, so I estimate about 90 kcal in total.
